2014_spells.ray-of-frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
2014_spells.ray-of-frost.effectSummary: Deal 1d8 cold damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.ray-of-frost.fullDescription: Using 1 action, on a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Make a ranged spell attack against the target; A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range; The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8). On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
